emailBrief.sql:
select "email_id", "send_email", "name", "subject", "code", "recipient", "to_email", "type", "status", "message", "unread", "create_time", "is_del", CASE WHEN trim(coalesce("text", '')) != '' THEN NULL ELSE trim(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(
		coalesce("email"."content", ''),
		char(13), ''),
		char(10), ''),
		char(9), ' '),
		'  ', ' '),
		'  ', ' '),
		'> <', '><')) END as "content", substr(coalesce("text", ''), 1, ?) as "text" from "email" where "email"."user_id" = ?
